children.title: The Observer Effect: Is Measurement Just Learning?

detail.title: The Observer Effect: Is Measurement Just Learning?
detail.lede: What happens when we look at the world? We often hear that the act of observing changes reality. But what if it's simpler? What if looking is just... learning?
detail.reason: Reflection on the recent synthesis of observer-effect research, fulfilling the reflection cycle 72.
